steps.what: Show the stored experiment plan for this material.
Conduct experiments to validate materials and startup protocols.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the experiment plan already written for this material. The fuel cell engineer conducts the experiment on the bench, including startup, conditioning, and contaminant checks. The plan does not run the bench. A plan with no material id leaves the work with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan was reprinted because the bench copy named a different material.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored plan can be opened. The experiment still has to be run.
tasks.still_hard: A contaminant the plan does not name still has to be watched on the bench.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer runs the experiment. The plan is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: The experiment stays on the bench. The stored plan is visible and is not treated as the run.

reach.task: Record the material that was actually put on the bench.
reach.learn: A plan title is not the experiment.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored experiment plan is a lookup. It does not validate a material or run a startup.
Conditioning time and contaminant tolerance are observed on the bench, not in the plan.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: The experiment id and the material id, both already stored. The plan text is not extended by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the plan in the document store before printing a second copy.
unknowns: Whether each material has one current plan or several competing drafts.
research_questions: Who marks an experiment plan as the one for this material?

already_counted.description: The bench experiment stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop plans whose material record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still plans and conducts the experiment on the bench, including startup, conditioning, and contaminant checks. Only opening a plan that was already written is removed. A plan with no material id saves none of the bench work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored question about this fuel cell system.
Provide technical consultation on development and production.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the question already logged about this fuel cell system. The fuel cell engineer gives technical consultation on development or production in the meeting. The stored question is not that direction. A question with no caller leaves the conversation with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice was repeated because the note only had the system name.
tasks.enabler_now: The logged question can be opened. The consultation still takes the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: A production constraint the note does not mention still has to be heard.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer gives the direction. The question is the note already written.
tasks.altitude: The consultation stays in the meeting. The stored question is visible and is not the direction.

reach.task: Name the production constraint before asking for direction.
reach.learn: A system name is not the consultation.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored question is a lookup. It does not give technical direction on development or production.
Consultation is a conversation. A stored summary is not the direction the engineer gives.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: The question id only if it is already logged. Advice is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the question in the document store before asking for a second copy.
unknowns: Whether development questions and production questions share one log.
research_questions: Who is in the room when the constraint is still unclear?

already_counted.description: The consultation stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop questions whose meeting has already been held.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still gives technical consultation on development or production. Only opening a question that was already logged is removed. A question with no caller saves none of the conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Generate operating points only when voltage, current, and condition are stored.
Characterize performances, define refinements, and execute durability assessments.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} builds an operating map only from points that already have voltage, current, and a condition. The fuel cell engineer characterizes performances, names design refinements, and executes the durability assessment. The map is filed only after the engineer accepts that version. A point with a missing measure is left out.
tasks.previous_blocker: An operating map mixed points from two different conditions and was treated as one characterization.
tasks.enabler_now: Complete stored points can be plotted. The characterization and the durability run still belong to the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A refinement the points do not show still has to be named by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer characterizes the cell and runs the durability assessment. The map is the points already stored.
tasks.altitude: Durability and design refinements stay with the engineer. The map is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Read a characterization the fuel cell engineer has already accepted.
reach.learn: A plot of stored points is not the refinement.

evidence.claim: Plotting stored voltage, current, and condition is arithmetic on fields already held. It does not characterize the cell.
Filing a characterization before the engineer accepts that version would store a refinement nobody made.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.
Fields: Voltage, current, and condition on each point. A point missing any one of them is left out. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the points from the data platform before drawing a separate map.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the fuel cell engineer.
unknowns: Whether durability hours are stored on the same point row as voltage and current.
research_questions: Which condition names are allowed on an operating point?

already_counted.description: Characterization, refinements, and the durability run stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop map points whose test record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: point ids and the refinement sentence the engineer accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still characterizes performances, names refinements, and executes durability assessments. Only plotting points that already have voltage, current, and a condition, and filing the version already accepted, is removed. A missing measure saves none of that judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Multiply stored quantity by the stored price on each reduction line.
Plan improvement projects in collaboration with suppliers and customers.

tasks.design: The {ERP} multiplies a stored quantity by a stored price for each cost line. The fuel cell engineer still plans the reduction or improvement project with suppliers, support staff, or customers. A missing price stops that line, and no price is invented. The product of the two fields is not the project decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: A cost line was retyped from a quote, and the total no longer matched the quote.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored quantity and a stored price can be multiplied. The project is still planned with the other people.
tasks.still_hard: A supplier who will not hold the price still has to be heard in the meeting.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer plans the project with the others. The line cost is arithmetic on stored fields.
tasks.altitude: The collaboration stays in the meeting. A line cost is visible and is not the project decision.

reach.task: Keep the price that was checked against the supplier total.
reach.learn: A multiplied line is not the improvement decision.

evidence.claim: Quantity times a stored price is arithmetic. It does not decide a cost reduction or an improvement project.
A supplier quote is used only when a stored total already matches it. The collaboration stays with the people in the room.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A fuel cell engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the experiment, and a draft is not the accepted design.

Fields: Quantity and price, both already stored on the line. A quote amount only when a stored total already equals it. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the fuel cell engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the price from the buying record before multiplying. Do not type a second price.
unknowns: Whether support staff and customers share the same project meeting.
research_questions: Who checks a supplier total before the price is stored?

already_counted.description: Planning the project with suppliers and customers stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop prices whose supplier record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still plans the reduction or improvement project with the other people. Only multiplying a stored quantity by a stored price is removed. A missing price saves none of the collaboration, and no price is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The fuel cell engineer still runs the experiment, still gives the consultation, and still judges durability and cost. A stored plan can be opened. It does not run the bench.
reach: Materials staff supply a material record, and this job learns the experiment is still run on the bench.
Buyers hold a price, and this job learns a price line is not the improvement project.
skills_to_grow: Run the experiment from the plan, including the check the plan does not name.
Give technical direction in the conversation, not from a stored question.
Keep durability and the cost decision with the person who saw the cell.
role.ambitious_version: Experiments, consultations, durability judgements, and cost decisions stay with the engineer. A stored plan or price only shows what was already written.
